criteria.name: Story coherence
criteria.description: Titles alone form a coherent argument.

criteria.name: Title chain
criteria.description: Adjacent pages advance rather than repeat.

criteria.name: Content fit
criteria.description: No prose stuffed into KPI values; density matches page job.

criteria.name: Visual rhythm
criteria.description: Deck alternates hero, data, structure, calm and action appropriately.

criteria.name: Pattern fit
criteria.description: ED pattern matches the information task.

criteria.name: Layout readability
criteria.description: No collision, clipping, tiny type or broken connectors.

criteria.name: Typography & spacing
criteria.description: Hierarchy and grouping are immediately legible.

criteria.name: Editability
criteria.description: Core content remains editable in PowerPoint.
